reason: This plugin is a client-side UI utility for DeepSeek Harness that improves the model picker by adding a searchable field to quickly narrow model options; based on the README it focuses on local list filtering and keyboard UX only, with no stated changes to model configuration or selection behavior.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 客户端插件，在模型选择器中新增搜索框，用于快速筛选模型并支持快捷键聚焦与清空查询。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness client plugin that adds a search field to the model picker so you can quickly filter models and use shortcuts to focus or clear the query.

capabilities: Adds a searchable input field to the composer model picker.
Filters visible models and descriptions in real time with case-insensitive matching.
Keeps provider headings when matching models exist.
Provides keyboard shortcuts for focusing and clearing the search query.
Limits behavior to client-side list filtering without changing model selection logic.
